{{Quote|They are a machine, created by the Sith Lord Ieldis to turn subject peoples into strong armies. A machine that has never been turned off, centuries after Ieldis turned to dust.|[[Ralthar Sitan]]|<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic 46">[[Knights of the Old Republic 46|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 46]]</ref>}}
'''Ieldis''' was a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Old Sith Empire]] who was responsible for the creation of the [[The Crucible|Crucible]], a massive organization that created standing [[Army/Legends|armies]] from the refugees created during war. During his life, he created a [[Sith sword]] known as the [[Sword of Ieldis]] as well as a helm known as the [[Helm of Ieldis]]. Ieldis eventually died, but even after his [[Death/Legends|death]], the Crucible lived on.
